marie (CISO): quick follow-up from the security segment — auditors asked about our chain-of-custody for logs and keys when data moves between regions or during key rotation. what artifacts should teams bundle for SOC2/ISO reviews?

devon (eng): do auditors want raw logs + checksums, or some signed manifest?

marie (CISO): good q. ideally both — raw logs, a digest (sha256), and a signed manifest that ties the export to the rotation event and deploy id. also include the KMS key version used and rotation timestamp.

anita (product): for feature teams that only use hosted endpoints, what is the simplest checklist they can follow?

marie (CISO): checklist idea: 1) export id + time window, 2) storage location (bucket path), 3) digest file, 4) key version metadata, 5) access-control ACLs & who pulled it, 6) redaction notes if PII removed. keep it minimal but auditably linked.

sylas (infra): we can add an `audit-manifest.json` to the export job with fields: `export_id`, `started_by`, `kms_key_arn`, `kms_key_version`, `rotation_event_id`, `sha256_manifest`. example command:```bash
redwoodctl audit export --since 2024-02-01 --until 2024-02-28 --out s3://redwood-audits/exports/2024-02 --manifest audit-manifest.json
```

devon (eng): nice. what about cross-region replication — when logs are copied to a secondary region for DR, do we re-sign manifests?

marie (CISO): yes, annotate replication events. either append a replication block to the original manifest with `replica_region`, `replica_time`, and `replica_digest`, or create a child manifest that references the parent export id. auditors like a clear chain.

anita (product): DSARs concern — if we need to redact before export, how do we document redaction in the manifest without exposing the redaction rules publicly?

marie (CISO): include a redaction flag and a reference id to the redaction ticket (e.g., RD-1234) rather than the full rule text. teams can fetch rule details under a secure ticket for auditors during review.

sylas (infra): operational note — we'll add a small endpoint in the audit service that returns signed metadata for an export. that signed blob will be attached to the manifest so teams don't have to assemble it manually.

audit-bot: :information_source: export job started (id: exp-20240228-77) for s3://redwood-audits/exports/2024-02 (initiated by sylas).

devon (eng): thanks — can we get a template manifest to include in the release notes / runbook? :thumbsup:

marie (CISO): yes — i'll post a template and a short office-hours slot to walk through it. tentatively next Tue 11am PT. tagging @devon @sylas @anita — please add any blockers. :eyes:

sylas (infra): i'm good. i'll also add a small section to the infra runbook showing `redwoodctl` flags.

anita (product): will prep a product-friendly checklist for hosted teams.

marie (CISO): action items: sylas -> prototype manifest endpoint, devon -> integrate manifest into export job, anita -> checklist for hosted teams. i'll create a follow-up thread with the template and the office-hours invite. thanks, everyone. :clap:
